t: This is the Cherry Groce Memorial Pavilion, standing in Windrush Square in Brixton. It remembers Dorothy, known as Cherry, Groce, a Black British woman who was a victim of police violence. The pavilion was designed by the architect Sir David Adjaye and unveiled in 2021. Adjaye is a Ghanaian-British architect, knighted in 2017, whose work includes the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington. In 2021 he received the Royal Gold Medal, the first African to do so.
